title: Delivery & Returns
seo_title: Dog Bed Delivery UK: Free Standard Over £40 | PawLunova
seo_description: Measured, chosen, now waiting? Dog bed delivery in the UK: standard delivery is free on orders over £40, and options show at checkout. See what's next.
body_html:
You've measured the dog and picked the bed, and now there's the wait while the old one looks flatter by the day. Here's how dog bed delivery in the UK works with us, and what happens if the bed turns out not to be the one.

Dog bed delivery in the UK

  • Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Every bed in our current range is priced above £40, so a single bed qualifies on its own.
  • Options and costs at checkout. You'll see the delivery options for your order, and any cost, at checkout before you pay.
  • Timings and lead times. Delivery timings, and any lead time that applies to a particular product, are set out in our shipping policy.
  • Personalised beds are made to order. Each one carries your dog's name, so order in good time, especially before Christmas, and check the spelling before you pay.

If you need a bed by a particular date, or you're ordering for an address outside the UK mainland, ask us first and we'll tell you what's possible.

When your bed arrives

Unpack it where it's going to live and check it over. If anything arrives faulty, damaged or not as described, contact us: your full legal rights apply. Before the first wash, read the sewn-in care label on the cover, and never wash or soak the foam itself.

Returns: 100 nights on most beds

Most of our beds come with the 100-night sleep trial. You have 100 nights from delivery; if the bed isn't right, contact us within that time and we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply.

Three exceptions, each stated on its product page:

  • Outdoor dog houses and day beds have a 30-day change-of-mind window, with return at your cost, not the 100-night sleep trial.
  • Personalised beds are made to order, so they're excluded from the trial and from change-of-mind returns.
  • The Whinlatter car seat is sold as a travel accessory, so ask us or check the returns terms before you order it.

Your statutory rights are unaffected. Read the full returns and guarantee terms in our refund policy.

Delivery and returns questions

Is dog bed delivery free in the UK?

Yes, on standard delivery: we offer free standard UK delivery on orders over £40, and every bed we currently sell is priced above that.

How do I send back a bed my dog won't use?

You don't post it. Contact us within 100 nights of delivery with your order number, and we arrange free collection from a UK mainland address and refund you in full. Outdoor and personalised products work differently, as above.

Do I pay to return an outdoor dog house?

For a change of mind, yes. Outdoor dog houses and day beds have a 30-day change-of-mind window with return at your cost. If one arrives faulty, damaged or not as described, that's different: your statutory rights apply.

Can you check the size before I order?

Yes. Send us your dog's breed and weight, or for a crate bed the inside measurements of your crate base, and we'll tell you honestly which size fits. Our size guide explains how to measure.

Still choosing? The Bed Finder asks four questions about your dog and suggests one bed.
